title: FLA import: tween ease value silently dropped (r.skip(2) at line 1764)
description: flash8-binary.ts line 1764 reads r.skip(2) for the signed 16-bit acceleration/ease value stored in every motion/shape tween keyframe. The model has motionEase on Keyframe and flash8-import.ts maps tweenType correctly, but all eased tweens from real Flash 8 FLAs import as linear (ease=0). Fix: r.i16() read flowing into createFrame({ motionEase: value }).
